proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / FY2013 COLLECTION OF TAXES`, PDF page 83 of the FY2013 annual town report (printed page 79). THE PAGE IS LANDSCAPE and has NO TEXT LAYER, so it was rotated upright and read off its own 400 dpi bitmap. COLUMN NAMES READ OFF THE PRINTED HEADER (rule 13b.4), verbatim and left to right: `COLLECTION OF TAXES`, `FORWARD`, `COMMITTMENTS` (the page's own spelling), `ADJUSTMENTS`, `REFUNDS`, `PAYMENTS`, `ABATEMENTS`, `TRANSFER`, `BALANCES`. Figures printed in parentheses are stored NEGATIVE, as the page prints them; `-` is the page's explicit zero. THE SCAN IS SKEWED AND THE LABEL COLUMN DRIFTS AGAINST THE FIGURES -- by the foot of the page a row label sits about one row pitch above its own figures, so NO ROW WAS ASSIGNED BY EYE. Each column's values were read in printed order and the assignment was settled by the arithmetic, which is rule 13b's own guarantee: a wrong layout cannot make real arithmetic close. TWO CHECKS, AND BOTH CLOSE COMPLETELY. (1) EVERY ROW STATES AN IDENTITY: forward + committments + adjustments + refunds + payments + abatements + transfer = balances. 57 OF 57 ROWS CLOSE TO THE CENT. (2) ALL EIGHT COLUMNS SUM TO THE `GRAND TOTAL` the page prints, to the cent: 1,651,248.72 / 22,523,058.03 / (25,688.60) / 93,375.26 / (22,091,835.42) / (171,928.23) / (317,778.88) / 1,660,450.88. No tolerance is declared and none was needed. ONE COLUMN ASSIGNMENT WAS CORRECTED BY THE TOTALS AND IS WORTH RECORDING. Five figures in the betterment and sewer block -- (434.57), (104.59), (5,390.09), (2,862.44) and (28,226.44) -- were first placed in ABATEMENTS. The row identities still closed, because both columns add, but the COLUMN totals came out exactly 37,018.13 wrong in opposite directions. Those five sum to 37,018.13, they sit at the same x as the (281.32) on the TAX LIENS row, and the ABATEMENTS column is empty throughout that block. A row identity alone could not have caught it; the printed column totals did. WHAT THIS IS. A receivable is money BILLED and not yet collected, by levy year and by kind -- motor vehicle excise (MVE), personal property (PP), real estate (RE), supplementals, tax liens, rollback taxes and the betterment and sewer commitments. It is NOT revenue and it is NOT an appropriation. The FY2013 receipts page (PDF page 63) counts what came IN; this page counts what is still owed.
